description: Audit, build, and refine interfaces with evidence-based findings and accessibility guidance.

defaultPrompt: Review my billing page and prioritize improvements. Do not change files yet.

interface.longDescription:
Build new screens, critique existing interfaces, or rethink an entire visual direction. Design Partner works in your project to improve layout, typography, color, motion, interaction states, and accessibility.

Its 19 modes cover design audits, responsive layouts, brand expression, reusable components and tokens, and final polish. Remove generic AI-looking patterns, strengthen a landing page’s identity, or make a dashboard hold up to real data, loading, and errors.

Ask for findings only or implementation. The agent uses your existing stack, carries relevant audit findings into follow-up work, and reports what it verified.
